definitions.explanation: The northern part of a country, in Japan especially Hokkaido, Tohoku and the Japan Sea coast, thought of as cold and snowy.

examples.english: Winters in the north are long.

examples.japanese: {北国|きたぐに}⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: I grew up in the north, so I can take the cold.

examples.japanese: {北国|きたぐに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧、⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧になって⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: Spring comes late in the north; the cherry trees don't bloom until May.

notes:
USAGE:
Has a lyrical, nostalgic ring and is common in songs and travel writing. In older and literary use it is also read ほっこく, as in {北国街道|ほっこくかいどう}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{雪国|ゆきぐに}→雪国：14608_yukiguni⟧: snow country, stressing deep snow; {北国|きたぐに} stresses the north
- ⟦{南国|なんごく}→南国：31674_nangoku⟧: the warm south, the opposite
